naya.title: NayaNET Personal Superbrain Federation — Naya Note
naya.summary: NayaNET should federate autonomous private Superbrains through explicit permissioned bridges rather than centralize raw personal memory.
lessons: The personal Superbrain must remain complete with federation disabled.
The default exchange unit is knowledge, not raw memory.
A simple permission UI must sit above real authorization, privacy transformation, provenance, audit, and revocation controls.
Collective CIS must preserve provenance classes and disagreement rather than overwrite personal truth.
next_best_actions: Implement personal-to-network federation contracts only after personal Superbrain and CIS gates are stable.
Design authenticated API bridge and privacy transformation layer.

human.title: NayaNET Personal Superbrain Federation — Shawn Note
human.summary: Each person gets a private Naya Power Superbrain and can choose to connect it to NayaNET so the network learns together without making private brains public.
lessons: Make connection simple for humans with clear permission choices.
Keep personal memory and CIS private by default.
Share collective lessons rather than personal identity or raw conversations by default.
Build the personal Superbrain first, then securely federate it.
next_best_actions: Build the mobile-first personal Superbrain control surface.
